name: cutg
description: Technical foundation for cutG, a barber operations and client booking platform.

scripts.dev: node scripts/dev-preflight.mjs && pnpm dev:infra && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --restart-tries 4 --restart-after 1500 -n api,web,ai-api,ai-worker -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:ai" "pnpm dev:ai-worker"
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio minio-init
scripts.field-test:prepare: pnpm dev:infra && make wait-for-postgres && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.field-test: CUTG_PREFLIGHT_SCOPE=field-test node scripts/dev-preflight.mjs && pnpm dev:infra && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --restart-tries 4 --restart-after 1500 -n api,web,tunnel -c blue,green,cyan "pnpm dev:api" "NEXT_PUBLIC_FIELD_TEST_MODE=true API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4000 pnpm dev:web" "node scripts/start-field-test-tunnel.mjs"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @barber-saas/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @barber-saas/shared-utils build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm test:api && pnpm --filter @barber-saas/web test && pnpm --filter @barber-saas/mobile test && pnpm test:ai
scripts.test:api:local: docker compose up -d postgres-test && pnpm test:api
